stemMd: Le Corbusier's Unité d'habitation included in the UNESCO serial property is in which city?
explanationMd: The Unité d'habitation named by UNESCO is in Marseille, France. Other listed cities also contain Le Corbusier works but of different types. Identifying the project requires matching both name and place.

distractorRationale.c: Tokyo contains his National Museum of Western Art.
distractorRationale.d: This is associated with his Capitol Complex.
distractorRationale.a: This is associated with the Curutchet House.
distractorRationale.e: This is not the Unité's location.
